verdicts_or_reports.screen: Main screen — category list grid (opened via the category tag with "Category list mode" enabled)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Each category card in the category list should show its resolved category icon (e.g. Food/Transport/Coffee icons) above the category name, since this build resolves category icons together with the category list.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The category cards are large blank tiles showing only the category name (Coffee, Transport, Food) at the bottom-left; the entire upper area of each card where the category icon should be rendered is empty for every category.
steps: Open Settings > Extra features and enable 'Category list mode'
Return to the home screen and tap a number so the category tag appears
Tap the category tag to open the saved-category grid
Observe the Coffee, Transport and Food cards: no category icon is rendered on any card

harness_replies: Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.
